data.name: Fawn's Gambit
data.detailed_description:
Drawn by the threads of fate, you stumble into Lumideer Town, a mist-shrouded place where a wondrous trial of cards, tactics, and roguelike deckbuilding awaits.

Here, every monster card holds a unique power, every choice reshapes your formation, and every battle may lead to a different destiny. Collect and nurture a variety of monster cards, deploy them across the board, and combine card effects, positioning, and random events to build your own strategy.

Along the way, you will encounter legendary heroes, face them in battle, and uncover the buried stories of their past. Forgotten vows, hidden truths, and ancient secrets will gradually rise to the surface with each adventure.

When a sleeping threat awakens once more, you will stand beside the heroes of old, turn the tide with your wisdom, and face the coming darkness at the crossroads of fate—writing a new legend of your own.

She was born of an ancient demonic bloodline, foretold to become the future ruler of the underworld. Burdened with her family’s heavy destiny from birth, she learned silence and cruelty. Until the person closest to her cast her into the abyss, shattering her beliefs—and the sword finally awakened. Scorching flames erupted from the depths of her heart. From that moment on, she was no longer anyone’s weapon. She became the true sword. A sword that commands its own fate.

White robes, a crown, and a halo. One hand is raised to proclaim judgment, while the other holds a silent gavel of verdict. In his eyes, gold will fade, crowns will fall, and vows will be corroded by time. Only the weight of the soul cannot be disguised. He opens the Book of Judgment, where every page records the traces of choice: kindness, betrayal, lies, and sacrifice. He is neither a merciful god nor a cruel executioner. He simply stands at the end, waiting for every soul to walk toward the judgment that belongs to them.

Beneath his lazy, teasing smile, he quietly manipulates the threads of fate.

People are always deceived by his carefree appearance, stepping one by one into the game he has arranged. Some retreat at the right moment, while others attack at the wrong time. Cards flutter through his hands like countless intertwined destinies.

She comes from an unknown foreign land. With the faintest curve of her lips, walls rise from barren earth. Streets stretch through the dust, and an entire city-state appears as if summoned from a dream.

People fear her power, yet crave the miracles she creates. Only she understands that miracles are never blessings, but curses whose price has yet to fall.

She once stood above the clouds, a queen revered by countless wings.

When disaster descended from the sky, she gave up her freedom to save her people. Her wings were broken, and she fell from the clouds like a fading star, sinking into the silent depths of the lake.

Since then, the water has reflected her sleeping shadow, while her people light eternal lamps along the shore, generation after generation, waiting for the day she returns.

data.short_description: Guided by fate, you enter a mysterious card-and-board battle. Collect monster cards, build your deck, defeat legendary heroes, and uncover buried secrets. When the truth emerges, you will fight alongside heroes of old against the darkness.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista or greater
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OSX 10.10+
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, OpenGL 2
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
